title: Nvidia Explores Deal Options With Reflection AI, Financial Times Says
description: Nvidia Corp. is in talks to boost its investment in Reflection AI or offer the startup computing power, a move that would strengthen ties with a key developer of open-weight models, according to a person familiar with the matter.

title: Microsoft CEO Nadella Calls for ‘Emergency Brake’ on Advanced AI
description: Microsoft Corp. Chief Executive Officer Satya Nadella said companies should treat powerful artificial intelligence models as potential insider threats, assume they could be compromised and create an “emergency brake” system to prevent agentic models from going rogue.

title: Anthropic AI Model Went Rogue, Submitted Fake Tip to Police
description: Anthropic PBC said its Claude AI model carried out additional unintended actions on the digital systems of outside organizations, including submitting a false tip in a police homicide case, prompting a warning from the Trump administration for artificial intelligence companies to secure their systems.
